goal: Measure effective pollinator dependency directly in the same tagged Izu populations rather than inferring dependency from floral form, family or realized interaction breadth, while preserving a separate strict functional-exposure path for dependency x FDQ analyses.
required_linked_channels: usable observation effort including zero-visit windows
single-visit pollen deposition on previously unvisited receptive stigmas
parallel_fdq_channels: confirmed visitor_taxon_id for each positive-abundance visit used in FDQ
site-linked numeric proboscis_length_mm for each positive-abundance visitor taxon
usable observation effort including zero-visit windows so empty exposure units remain explicit
optional_calibration_channels: blinded technical recounts of the same preserved SVD sample linked by svd_id
independent repeated estimates of the final direct dependency estimand for prespecified taxon x site x season target units
effective_service_definition: observed visit bouts per monitored flower-hour multiplied by background-adjusted mean single-visit conspecific pollen deposition for the same visitor group and population
core_reproductive_ratios: bagged_autonomous capsule set / supplemental_outcross capsule set
open_pollinated capsule set / supplemental_outcross capsule set

functional_exposure_readiness.estimand: abundance-weighted Rao quadratic entropy of pollinator proboscis length
functional_exposure_readiness.formula: sum_i sum_j p_i p_j abs(L_i - L_j)
functional_exposure_readiness.exposure_unit: population_id x field_event_id x island_id x site_id

prospective_trait_measurement.below_target_admission: allowed only when all_available_at_site=yes explicitly records that all available specimens were measured

historical_trait_recovery.target_source: electronic supplementary material Table S2 / Dryad primary_data.xlsx
historical_trait_recovery.blocking_scope: blocks exact reuse of historical source-native trait values but does not block prospective measured_new traits

strict_fdq_gate: every scored positive-abundance visit in an FDQ exposure unit has confirmed taxon identity
every positive-abundance visitor taxon has an admitted numeric site-linked proboscis trait
unresolved or missing-trait visits are retained diagnostically and are not dropped before renormalization
zero-visit usable effort is retained but is not relabelled as FDQ equals zero
functional_exposure_readiness.boundary: A valid SVD/effective-service/dependency panel may exist while FDQ is withheld. Conversely, FDQ does not establish pollinator effectiveness or reproductive dependency.

why_no_fixed_sample_threshold_yet: SVD and treatment dispersion must come from a pilot or external species-specific calibration. Structural completion is intentionally separated from precision/power adequacy.

pilot_precision_state_machine.next_gate: collect linked pilot rows from multiple independent plants

replace synthetic variance, coverage and loss assumptions with pilot summaries; separately identify measurement reliability/error rather than relabelling biological repeats; then lock a biologically meaningful absolute CI half-width
calculate approximate independent-plant replication from pilot between-plant SD only after frozen-byte and admission guards pass
stress-test site/time replication, dependency support, expected loss, visitor availability and hierarchical model by simulation before final field lock

measurement_calibration.estimand: technical repeatability of conspecific pollen counting on the same preserved SVD sample
measurement_calibration.minimum_for_repeatability_estimation: at least three distinct SVD samples with two or more independent recounts each
measurement_calibration.boundary: Technical recount repeatability informs only the pollen-count measurement component. It must not be substituted directly for dependency_reliability in the dependency x FDQ design simulation.

direct_dependency_reliability_calibratio.target_unit: prespecified taxon x site x season unit
direct_dependency_reliability_calibratio.eligible_repeat: same final estimand and protocol, non-overlapping plant panel, distinct frozen source bundle
direct_dependency_reliability_calibratio.minimum_for_scope_reliability_estimation: at least three target units with two or more eligible independent repeat blocks each and at least two independent plants per repeat block
direct_dependency_reliability_calibratio.boundary: An estimable reliability ratio inside the calibration scope still requires a separate transportability review before it can replace synthetic dependency_reliability in a cross-lineage dependency x FDQ design.

comparator_rule: Choose comparators from direct interaction/reproductive evidence and phenological feasibility; do not assign specialist/generalist classes from floral syndrome labels.
high_dependency_endpoint_rule: A high-dependency endpoint must be demonstrated by direct effective-pollinator data or an external prespecified calibration; it is not preassigned from corolla morphology.
dependency_gradient_rule: A confirmatory dependency x FDQ test should distribute directly measured taxa across low, intermediate and high dependency support. One endpoint or many taxa inside one narrow survivor range is insufficient.

prospective_design_simulation.main_design_result: Under declared synthetic alternatives, broad directly measured dependency support improves interaction recovery more than adding proxy rows while support remains narrow.

survivorship_rule: Non-establishment, hybrid replacement and interaction rewiring remain response modes and must not be excluded solely because a pure same-lineage island survivor is unavailable.
service_output_guard: Official CLI output withholds background-adjusted SVD, rate-weighted effective service and service share when a visitor group lacks a no-visit SVD control.
claim_boundary: The direct field panel can estimate contemporary per-visit effectiveness, rate-weighted effective service and reproductive dependence in sampled populations. The ordinary pilot can estimate plant-level dispersion, coverage and attrition after admission, while technical recounts estimate pollen-count repeatability only. FDQ is a separate functional-exposure gate and must not be inferred from visitor groups, richness or body-size classes. Neither panel identifies the final direct-dependency reliability ratio without an independent repeated-final-estimand design. The panel does not by itself identify historical Bombus loss, historical selection, self-compatibility, realized selfing, empirical dependency x FDQ moderation, or a causal Oshima-Toshima boundary effect. The prospective design simulation uses synthetic dependency and effect assumptions only.
